summary: Clears two flag bytes, this+0xF4 and this+0xF5, to 0 and forwards the sub-object pointer stored at this+0x40 to FieldSetterCall with parameter 2. Returns 0. No guards; all operations are unconditional.

operations.description: Forward the pointer at this+0x40 to FieldSetterCall with parameter 2, setting the sub-object field state.
Clear the flag byte at this+0xF4 to 0.
Clear the flag byte at this+0xF5 to 0.

unresolved: The meaning of FieldSetterCall parameter 2 for the sub-object at this+0x40 is DERIVED in existing analysis (clear action) but not deterministically established by this function alone.
Whether this+0xF4 and this+0xF5 are independent flags or adjacent members of a larger field block is unresolved.
